Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class TwoPhaseDropletSlipClosure

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.TwoPhaseDropletSlipClosure
final class TwoPhaseDropletSlipClosure extends Object
Bounded prescribed-slip closure for spherical liquid droplets dispersed in a continuous gas.

The caller supplies the droplet Sauter mean diameter and the gas-to-droplet relative speed. The closure solves the two positive phase velocities that retain the homogeneous-state kinetic energy, then derives phase areas and mass flux from continuity. It accepts only dilute spherical droplets with Eo <= 4, We <= 12, and liquid area fraction at most 0.20. It does not predict droplet size, slip, breakup, coalescence, entrainment, or annular flow.
